questions.question_en: The Sea of Japan lies between Japan and which two other countries?
questions.explanation_en: The Sea of Japan is bordered by Japan, Korea and Russia.

questions.question_en: The Arabian Sea lies to the west of which country's coastline?
questions.explanation_en: The Arabian Sea lies west of the Indian coast and south of Pakistan and Iran.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Greenland?
questions.explanation_en: Nuuk is the capital of Greenland.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Iceland?
questions.explanation_en: Reykjavik is the capital of Iceland.

questions.question_en: Which country lies on the equator and has the capital Quito?
questions.explanation_en: Ecuador's capital, Quito, sits near the equator.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Rwanda?
questions.explanation_en: Kigali is the capital of Rwanda.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Norway?
questions.explanation_en: Oslo is the capital of Norway.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Sweden?
questions.explanation_en: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation_en: Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of Ghana?
questions.explanation_en: Accra is the capital of Ghana.

questions.question_en: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explanation_en: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.
